    Atomic invariants — fivefolds¶

    Atomic invariants · Geometric catalogue · Exact data

    The factor numbers below refer to the characteristic polynomial of A=c1⋆ A = c 1 ⋆ at the stated point. Each row applies separately at every root of its indicated factor. Long exact polynomials and determinants are retained in the downloadable data.

    Complete intersection (2,2,2,2) in P⁹¶

    Construction, inputs and matrix

    Dimension: 5. Ambient rank: 6. Full cohomology rank: 332. Full Hodge-invariant rank: 6.

    Full Hodge polynomial: PX(t)=4t3+159t+6+159t−1+4t−3 P X ( t ) = 4 t 3 + 159 t + 6 + 159 t − 1 + 4 t − 3 .

    Analysis point: y1=2. Unit determinant: nonzero.

    Generality: Smooth regular complete intersection.

    Factor of A A Distinct roots ρα ρ α per root Full rank per root Pα(t) P α ( t ) per root
    1 1 4 330 4t3+159t+4+159t−1+4t−3 4 t 3 + 159 t + 4 + 159 t − 1 + 4 t − 3
    2 2 1 1 1 1

    Hodge identification: Very-general ample complete intersection: weak Lefschetz and irreducible non-Tate vanishing cohomology.

    Primitive assignment: Chern index at least two; see the common proof rules.

    Exact characteristic factors of A at this point 
    factor 1: lambda; multiplicity per root 4
